_about: Filipino (Tagalog) for graph content. DRAFT pending review by a Filipino speaker. Each entry keeps the English it was translated from ("en"); if the English changes, the validator reports the entry as stale. Official office and document names stay in English on purpose.

office:mkn.barangay:note.en: Not covered by the Marikina charters read; confirm with your barangay.
office:mkn.barangay:note.tl: Hindi sakop ng mga nabasang Marikina charter; kumpirmahin sa iyong barangay.

office:mkn.cpdo:note.en: Issues the Locational Clearance; not modelled in this graph.
office:mkn.cpdo:note.tl: Nag-iisyu ng Locational Clearance; hindi kasama sa graph na ito.

office:mkn.obo:note.en: Address and phone are not stated in the sources read; confirm with City Hall.
office:mkn.obo:note.tl: Hindi nakasaad sa mga nabasang source ang address at telepono; kumpirmahin sa City Hall.

office:mkn.pdao:note.en: Address and phone are not stated in the sources read; confirm with CSWDO / City Hall.
office:mkn.pdao:note.tl: Hindi nakasaad sa mga nabasang source ang address at telepono; kumpirmahin sa CSWDO / City Hall.

office:qc.barangay:note.en: Not covered by QC charters; confirm requirements and fees with your barangay.
office:qc.barangay:note.tl: Hindi sakop ng mga QC charter; kumpirmahin sa iyong barangay ang mga requirement at bayad.

requirement:mkn.r-colb-form102:hint.en: From the hospital, lying-in clinic or other birthing facility.
requirement:mkn.r-colb-form102:hint.tl: Mula sa ospital, lying-in clinic o ibang birthing facility.

requirement:mkn.r-eboss:hint.en: Check your compliance status on the E-BOSS portal: https://bplo.marikina.gov.ph/client
requirement:mkn.r-eboss:hint.tl: Tingnan ang iyong compliance status sa E-BOSS portal: https://bplo.marikina.gov.ph/client

requirement:mkn.r-med-cert:hint.en: From a medical doctor, ophthalmologist, neurologist or orthopedic doctor.
requirement:mkn.r-med-cert:hint.tl: Mula sa medical doctor, ophthalmologist, neurologist o orthopedic doctor.

requirement:mkn.r-public-liability:hint.en: From any accredited insurance company (City Ordinance No. 32, Series of 2013).
requirement:mkn.r-public-liability:hint.tl: Mula sa kahit anong accredited na insurance company (City Ordinance No. 32, Series of 2013).

requirement:qc.r-cert-disability:hint.en: Must be signed by the specialist for your disability type, not a family doctor or general physician.
requirement:qc.r-cert-disability:hint.tl: Dapat pirmado ng specialist para sa uri ng iyong disability, hindi ng family doctor o general physician.

requirement:qc.r-colb-4:hint.en: From the hospital, maternity/lying-in clinic or birthing facility.
requirement:qc.r-colb-4:hint.tl: Mula sa ospital, maternity/lying-in clinic o birthing facility.

service:mkn.s-birth-ctc:in_person:note.en: Records registered at the Marikina City Civil Registry only. The same fee is shown for birth, marriage and death copies. Walk-in only in the sources read.
service:mkn.s-birth-ctc:in_person:note.tl: Para lamang sa mga rekord na nakarehistro sa Marikina City Civil Registry. Pareho ang bayad para sa kopya ng birth, marriage at death. Walk-in lamang ayon sa mga nabasang source.

service:mkn.s-birth-ctc:in_person:step:1.en: Fill out the request form at LCRO Window 4 and submit it; the verifier checks availability in the database and issues the order of payment
service:mkn.s-birth-ctc:in_person:step:1.tl: Punan ang request form sa LCRO Window 4 at isumite; titingnan ng verifier kung nasa database ito at magbibigay ng order of payment

service:mkn.s-birth-ctc:in_person:step:2.en: Pay the CTC fee at the City Treasurer’s office and get the Official Receipt
service:mkn.s-birth-ctc:in_person:step:2.tl: Bayaran ang CTC fee sa City Treasurer’s office at kunin ang Official Receipt

service:mkn.s-birth-ctc:in_person:step:3.en: Bring the OR to LCRO Window 4 to receive the certified copy
service:mkn.s-birth-ctc:in_person:step:3.tl: Dalhin ang OR sa LCRO Window 4 para makuha ang certified copy

service:mkn.s-birth-registration:exit_me.en: Registration after 30 days follows the late-registration process. Contact the City Civil Registry Office (Window 5).
service:mkn.s-birth-registration:exit_me.tl: Ang pagpaparehistro lampas sa 30 araw ay dumadaan sa late-registration na proseso. Makipag-ugnayan sa City Civil Registry Office (Window 5).

service:mkn.s-birth-registration:in_pers.en: For births in Marikina City. Walk-in only in the sources read.
service:mkn.s-birth-registration:in_pers.tl: Para sa mga ipinanganak sa Marikina City. Walk-in lamang ayon sa mga nabasang source.

service:mkn.s-birth-registration:in_pers.en: Submit the Certificate of Live Birth and requirements at LCRO; staff check completeness and give an order of payment
service:mkn.s-birth-registration:in_pers.tl: Isumite ang Certificate of Live Birth at mga requirement sa LCRO; titingnan ng staff kung kumpleto at magbibigay ng order of payment

service:mkn.s-birth-registration:in_pers.en: Pay the registration fee at the City Treasurer’s office
service:mkn.s-birth-registration:in_pers.tl: Bayaran ang registration fee sa City Treasurer’s office

service:mkn.s-birth-registration:in_pers.en: Bring the Official Receipt to LCRO Window 5 and get a claim stub with the release date
service:mkn.s-birth-registration:in_pers.tl: Dalhin ang Official Receipt sa LCRO Window 5 at kumuha ng claim stub na may petsa ng release

service:mkn.s-building-permit:in_person:.en: Classified Highly Technical in the 2024 charter. Walk-in only in the sources read.
service:mkn.s-building-permit:in_person:.tl: Nakaklasipika bilang Highly Technical sa 2024 charter. Walk-in lamang ayon sa mga nabasang source.

service:mkn.s-building-permit:in_person:.en: Submit complete requirements at the receiving section; the clerk checks the application
service:mkn.s-building-permit:in_person:.tl: Isumite ang kumpletong requirement sa receiving section; susuriin ng clerk ang aplikasyon

service:mkn.s-building-permit:in_person:.en: Two copies of the plan are endorsed to BFP
service:mkn.s-building-permit:in_person:.tl: Dalawang kopya ng plano ang ie-endorse sa BFP

service:mkn.s-building-permit:in_person:.en: Technical evaluators check the electrical, sanitary, structural and architectural plans and property documents
service:mkn.s-building-permit:in_person:.tl: Susuriin ng mga technical evaluator ang electrical, sanitary, structural at architectural na plano at mga dokumento ng ari-arian

service:mkn.s-building-permit:in_person:.en: If compliant, the order of payment is prepared and approved; pay the permit fees at the cashier
service:mkn.s-building-permit:in_person:.tl: Kung compliant, ihahanda at aaprubahan ang order of payment; bayaran ang permit fees sa cashier

service:mkn.s-building-permit:in_person:.en: The Building Official approves and the releasing clerk releases the permit
service:mkn.s-building-permit:in_person:.tl: Aaprubahan ng Building Official at ire-release ng releasing clerk ang permit

service:mkn.s-business-permit-renewal:in.en: The charter lists 15 minutes per stage (file, pay) with no single total.
service:mkn.s-business-permit-renewal:in.tl: Nakalista sa charter ang 15 minuto bawat yugto (pag-file, pagbayad) pero walang kabuuang oras.

service:mkn.s-business-permit-renewal:in.en: File the duly accomplished application form with complete requirements at BPLO (evaluation, assessment, billing and permit)
service:mkn.s-business-permit-renewal:in.tl: I-file ang napunang application form kasama ang kumpletong requirement sa BPLO (evaluation, assessment, billing at permit)

service:mkn.s-business-permit-renewal:in.en: Pay at the Treasury Office cashier
service:mkn.s-business-permit-renewal:in.tl: Magbayad sa cashier ng Treasury Office

service:mkn.s-business-permit-renewal:in.en: Payment due dates for the current year: Jan 20, Apr 20, Jul 20, Oct 20 (1st to 4th quarter)
service:mkn.s-business-permit-renewal:in.tl: Mga petsa ng bayad ngayong taon: Ene 20, Abr 20, Hul 20, Okt 20 (1st hanggang 4th quarter)

service:mkn.s-business-permit-renewal:on.en: Check your eBOSS compliance status first at https://bplo.marikina.gov.ph/client.
service:mkn.s-business-permit-renewal:on.tl: Tingnan muna ang iyong eBOSS compliance status sa https://bplo.marikina.gov.ph/client.

service:mkn.s-business-permit-renewal:on.en: Sign in at payment.marikina.gov.ph, select Business Permit & Licensing Office, enter your Business Account Number and click Renew
service:mkn.s-business-permit-renewal:on.tl: Mag-sign in sa payment.marikina.gov.ph, piliin ang Business Permit & Licensing Office, ilagay ang iyong Business Account Number at i-click ang Renew

service:mkn.s-business-permit-renewal:on.en: Input the actual/annual declared gross sales and attach your financial statement and quarterly VAT, then Submit
service:mkn.s-business-permit-renewal:on.tl: Ilagay ang aktwal/taunang idineklarang gross sales at i-attach ang financial statement at quarterly VAT, saka i-Submit

service:mkn.s-business-permit-renewal:on.en: Select the business and quarter to pay, Compute Business Tax, Proceed to Checkout and pay (credit/debit card, GCash, Maya or Bayad App)
service:mkn.s-business-permit-renewal:on.tl: Piliin ang negosyo at quarter na babayaran, i-Compute ang Business Tax, Proceed to Checkout at magbayad (credit/debit card, GCash, Maya o Bayad App)

service:mkn.s-business-permit-renewal:on.en: An email confirmation is sent after a successful payment
service:mkn.s-business-permit-renewal:on.tl: May ipapadalang email confirmation pagkatapos ng matagumpay na bayad

service:mkn.s-portal-register:online:not.en: Fee and time are not stated in the sources read.
service:mkn.s-portal-register:online:not.tl: Hindi nakasaad sa mga nabasang source ang bayad at tagal.

service:mkn.s-portal-register:online:ste.en: Click Sign Up and input account information (password needs an uppercase, lowercase, number and special character)
service:mkn.s-portal-register:online:ste.tl: I-click ang Sign Up at ilagay ang impormasyon ng account (ang password ay dapat may malaking titik, maliit na titik, numero at special character)

service:mkn.s-portal-register:online:ste.en: Verify your email using the message sent to you
service:mkn.s-portal-register:online:ste.tl: I-verify ang iyong email gamit ang mensaheng ipinadala sa iyo

service:mkn.s-pwd-id:in_person:note.en: Walk-in only in the sources read. The 2022 omnibus charter gives a different total (11 minutes and 10 seconds); the 2024 charter is used.
service:mkn.s-pwd-id:in_person:note.tl: Walk-in lamang ayon sa mga nabasang source. Iba ang kabuuang oras sa 2022 omnibus charter (11 minuto at 10 segundo); ang 2024 charter ang ginamit.

service:mkn.s-pwd-id:in_person:step:1.en: Fill in the PWD form and be interviewed by the PDAO focal person
service:mkn.s-pwd-id:in_person:step:1.tl: Punan ang PWD form at magpa-interview sa PDAO focal person

service:mkn.s-pwd-id:in_person:step:2.en: Submit requirements, including pictures; staff review them and record them in the log book
service:mkn.s-pwd-id:in_person:step:2.tl: Isumite ang mga requirement, kasama ang mga litrato; susuriin ito ng staff at itatala sa log book

service:mkn.s-pwd-id:in_person:step:3.en: PWD card is issued and your information is encoded in the database
service:mkn.s-pwd-id:in_person:step:3.tl: Ibibigay ang PWD card at ie-encode ang iyong impormasyon sa database

service:mkn.s-pwd-id:in_person:step:4.en: Optional: request other assistance (burial, medical, assistive device, if available)
service:mkn.s-pwd-id:in_person:step:4.tl: Opsyonal: humingi ng ibang tulong (burial, medical, assistive device, kung mayroon)

service:mkn.s-senior-id:in_person:note.en: For Marikina residents aged 60 or older. Walk-in only in the sources read.
service:mkn.s-senior-id:in_person:note.tl: Para sa mga residente ng Marikina na 60 taong gulang pataas. Walk-in lamang ayon sa mga nabasang source.

service:mkn.s-senior-id:in_person:step:1.en: Submit the accomplished form with complete requirements; OSCA staff check them, interview you and encode your data
service:mkn.s-senior-id:in_person:step:1.tl: Isumite ang napunang form kasama ang kumpletong requirement; susuriin ito ng OSCA staff, iinterbyuhin ka, at ie-encode ang iyong datos

service:mkn.s-senior-id:in_person:step:2.en: Claim the Senior Citizen’s ID and booklet
service:mkn.s-senior-id:in_person:step:2.tl: Kunin ang Senior Citizen’s ID at booklet

service:qc.s-birth-ctc:in_person:note.en: For persons born in Quezon City; counters 1 & 2.
service:qc.s-birth-ctc:in_person:note.tl: Para sa mga ipinanganak sa Quezon City; counters 1 at 2.

service:qc.s-birth-ctc:in_person:step:1.en: Submit filled-out request form and ID; receive order of payment
service:qc.s-birth-ctc:in_person:step:1.tl: Isumite ang napunang request form at ID; tanggapin ang order of payment

service:qc.s-birth-ctc:in_person:step:2.en: Pay at the City Treasurer’s cashier; receive claim stub
service:qc.s-birth-ctc:in_person:step:2.tl: Magbayad sa cashier ng City Treasurer; tanggapin ang claim stub

service:qc.s-birth-ctc:online:step:1.en: Log in, click “Civil Registry Online Services”, then “Request for a Certificate”
service:qc.s-birth-ctc:online:step:1.tl: Mag-log in, i-click ang “Civil Registry Online Services”, saka ang “Request for a Certificate”

service:qc.s-birth-ctc:online:step:2.en: Wait for the email saying the copy is ready for pick-up
service:qc.s-birth-ctc:online:step:2.tl: Hintayin ang email na nagsasabing handa nang kunin ang kopya

service:qc.s-birth-ctc:online:step:3.en: Pick up at CCRD and pay at the City Treasurer’s Office
service:qc.s-birth-ctc:online:step:3.tl: Kunin sa CCRD at magbayad sa City Treasurer’s Office

service:qc.s-birth-registration:exit_mes.en: Registration after 30 days follows the delayed-registration process. Contact the City Civil Registry Department.
service:qc.s-birth-registration:exit_mes.tl: Ang pagpaparehistro lampas sa 30 araw ay dumadaan sa delayed-registration na proseso. Makipag-ugnayan sa City Civil Registry Department.

service:qc.s-birth-registration:in_perso.en: Submit the Certificate of Live Birth and all requirements at Counter 18
service:qc.s-birth-registration:in_perso.tl: Isumite ang Certificate of Live Birth at lahat ng requirement sa Counter 18

service:qc.s-birth-registration:in_perso.en: Receive the personal copy of the registered certificate
service:qc.s-birth-registration:in_perso.tl: Tanggapin ang personal na kopya ng narehistrong certificate

service:qc.s-birth-registration:online:s.en: Log in, “Civil Registry Online Services”, then “Birth Registration”
service:qc.s-birth-registration:online:s.tl: Mag-log in, piliin ang “Civil Registry Online Services”, saka ang “Birth Registration”

service:qc.s-birth-registration:online:s.en: Upload digital copies of the requirements
service:qc.s-birth-registration:online:s.tl: I-upload ang digital na kopya ng mga requirement

service:qc.s-birth-registration:online:s.en: After the email notice, submit the original documents at CCRD
service:qc.s-birth-registration:online:s.tl: Pagkatanggap ng email notice, isumite ang mga orihinal na dokumento sa CCRD

service:qc.s-building-permit:online:note.en: Payment window differs between sources: charter says Treasurer windows 13 or 14; the QCitizen guide says Counter 12. Confirm with DBO.
service:qc.s-building-permit:online:note.tl: Magkaiba ang payment window sa mga source: windows 13 o 14 ng Treasurer ayon sa charter; Counter 12 ayon sa QCitizen guide. Kumpirmahin sa DBO.

service:qc.s-building-permit:online:step.en: Log in to QC E-Services → Building Permit One-Stop Shop; generate application forms and checklist
service:qc.s-building-permit:online:step.tl: Mag-log in sa QC E-Services → Building Permit One-Stop Shop; gumawa ng application forms at checklist

service:qc.s-building-permit:online:step.en: Add or select building professionals; print checklist and forms
service:qc.s-building-permit:online:step.tl: Magdagdag o pumili ng mga building professional; i-print ang checklist at forms

service:qc.s-building-permit:online:step.en: Electronically submit for pre-evaluation and schedule an appointment
service:qc.s-building-permit:online:step.tl: I-submit online para sa pre-evaluation at magpa-schedule ng appointment

service:qc.s-building-permit:online:step.en: Drop off documents at the DBO kiosk on your appointment date
service:qc.s-building-permit:online:step.tl: Ihatid ang mga dokumento sa DBO kiosk sa araw ng iyong appointment

service:qc.s-building-permit:online:step.en: Claim the Order of Payment (bring valid ID) and pay at the City Treasurer’s cashier
service:qc.s-building-permit:online:step.tl: Kunin ang Order of Payment (magdala ng valid ID) at magbayad sa cashier ng City Treasurer
Ibalik ang OR; ire-release ang permit

service:qc.s-business-permit-renewal:onl.en: Charter lists 30 minutes per evaluation stage but no single total; the system can auto-renew if compliant.
service:qc.s-business-permit-renewal:onl.tl: Nakalista sa charter ang 30 minuto bawat yugto ng evaluation pero walang kabuuang oras; maaaring mag-auto-renew ang sistema kung compliant ka.

service:qc.s-business-permit-renewal:onl.en: File renewal via QC E-Services portal or kiosks: Business One-Stop Shop → Apply for Mayor’s Permit (Business) → Renewal
service:qc.s-business-permit-renewal:onl.tl: Mag-file ng renewal sa QC E-Services portal o kiosk: Business One-Stop Shop → Apply for Mayor’s Permit (Business) → Renewal

service:qc.s-business-permit-renewal:onl.en: Input Mayor’s Permit number and current-year business tax OR; submit requirements
service:qc.s-business-permit-renewal:onl.tl: Ilagay ang Mayor’s Permit number at ang OR ng business tax ngayong taon; isumite ang mga requirement

service:qc.s-business-permit-renewal:onl.en: Claim the renewed permit or have it delivered
service:qc.s-business-permit-renewal:onl.tl: Kunin ang na-renew na permit o ipa-deliver ito

service:qc.s-business-tax-payment:in_per.en: Online payment is also offered via QC E-Services (per the BPLD charter); details not captured here.
service:qc.s-business-tax-payment:in_per.tl: May online payment din sa QC E-Services (ayon sa BPLD charter); hindi nakuha rito ang mga detalye.

service:qc.s-business-tax-payment:in_per.en: Present the approved Computerized Business Tax Bill at the payment counter
service:qc.s-business-tax-payment:in_per.tl: Ipakita ang aprubadong Computerized Business Tax Bill sa payment counter

service:qc.s-business-tax-payment:in_per.en: Pay; receive the computerized business tax official receipt
service:qc.s-business-tax-payment:in_per.tl: Magbayad; tanggapin ang computerized business tax official receipt

service:qc.s-eservices-register:online:n.en: Fee and time not stated in the sources read.
service:qc.s-eservices-register:online:n.tl: Hindi nakasaad sa mga nabasang source ang bayad at tagal.

service:qc.s-eservices-register:online:s.en: Register at QC E-Services using a personal email (1 email per registrant)
service:qc.s-eservices-register:online:s.tl: Magparehistro sa QC E-Services gamit ang personal na email (isang email bawat nagpaparehistro)

service:qc.s-eservices-register:online:s.en: Confirm and validate the E-Services account
service:qc.s-eservices-register:online:s.tl: Kumpirmahin at i-validate ang E-Services account

service:qc.s-pwd-id:in_person:step:1.en: Bring copies of requirements to PDAO for evaluation
service:qc.s-pwd-id:in_person:step:1.tl: Dalhin ang mga kopya ng requirement sa PDAO para ma-evaluate

service:qc.s-pwd-id:in_person:step:2.en: Staff encode your information; it is approved and verified
service:qc.s-pwd-id:in_person:step:2.tl: Ie-encode ng staff ang iyong impormasyon; ito ay aaprubahan at ive-verify

service:qc.s-pwd-id:in_person:step:3.en: Printed ID is given to you
service:qc.s-pwd-id:in_person:step:3.tl: Ibibigay sa iyo ang naka-print na ID

service:qc.s-pwd-id:in_person:step:4.en: Applicants with missing requirements are assisted and advised
service:qc.s-pwd-id:in_person:step:4.tl: Ang mga aplikanteng kulang ang requirement ay tutulungan at papayuhan

service:qc.s-pwd-id:online:note.en: Non-apparent disability validation takes 2–3 days. Renewal of a white PWD ID is processed as a new application.
service:qc.s-pwd-id:online:note.tl: Ang validation para sa non-apparent disability ay inaabot ng 2–3 araw. Ang pag-renew ng puting PWD ID ay pinoproseso bilang bagong aplikasyon.

service:qc.s-pwd-id:online:step:1.en: Log in and choose the QCitizen ID eApplication icon
service:qc.s-pwd-id:online:step:1.tl: Mag-log in at piliin ang QCitizen ID eApplication icon

service:qc.s-pwd-id:online:step:2.en: Complete personal information and tick “Yes” for the Persons With Disability sector
service:qc.s-pwd-id:online:step:2.tl: Kumpletuhin ang personal na impormasyon at i-tick ang “Yes” para sa Persons With Disability sector

service:qc.s-pwd-id:online:step:3.en: Upload requirements; a virtual ID shows on submission, then agree and submit
service:qc.s-pwd-id:online:step:3.tl: I-upload ang mga requirement; may lalabas na virtual ID pagka-submit, saka pumayag at i-submit

service:qc.s-pwd-id:online:step:4.en: Monitor application status in your E-Services account
service:qc.s-pwd-id:online:step:4.tl: Bantayan ang status ng aplikasyon sa iyong E-Services account

service:qc.s-senior-id:in_person:note.en: Fee and processing time are not stated in the guide.
service:qc.s-senior-id:in_person:note.tl: Hindi nakasaad sa guide ang bayad at tagal ng pagproseso.

service:qc.s-senior-id:in_person:step:1.en: Download or obtain the Senior Citizen QC ID Application Form from OSCA
service:qc.s-senior-id:in_person:step:1.tl: I-download o kunin sa OSCA ang Senior Citizen QC ID Application Form

service:qc.s-senior-id:in_person:step:2.en: Submit the accomplished form and all documents for OSCA verification
service:qc.s-senior-id:in_person:step:2.tl: Isumite ang napunang form at lahat ng dokumento para sa verification ng OSCA

service:qc.s-senior-id:in_person:step:3.en: ID is sent to your home or can be picked up at OSCA
service:qc.s-senior-id:in_person:step:3.tl: Ipapadala ang ID sa iyong bahay o puwedeng kunin sa OSCA

service:qc.s-senior-id:online:note.en: Fee and processing time are not stated in the guide.
service:qc.s-senior-id:online:note.tl: Hindi nakasaad sa guide ang bayad at tagal ng pagproseso.

service:qc.s-senior-id:online:step:1.en: Create a profile and account with QC E-Services
service:qc.s-senior-id:online:step:1.tl: Gumawa ng profile at account sa QC E-Services

service:qc.s-senior-id:online:step:2.en: Select QC ID e-Application (or Request for Sectoral Status Change if you already hold a resident QC ID)
service:qc.s-senior-id:online:step:2.tl: Piliin ang QC ID e-Application (o Request for Sectoral Status Change kung may resident QC ID ka na)

service:qc.s-senior-id:online:step:4.en: Wait for the physical ID to be delivered
service:qc.s-senior-id:online:step:4.tl: Hintaying maihatid ang pisikal na ID
